resale_co.name: Resale Existing Structure Certificate of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: Ocean Gate Borough Construction / Code / Zoning office (Borough Official Inspector)
requirements: Visual inspection of structural and sanitary conditions, fire safety precautions, and any maintenance or zoning violations under Borough ordinances
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms (the form says they are required by law)
Fireplace and furnace certificates must be submitted with the application
Flood Elevation Certificate (1988 datum) if the home is in an effective or preliminary flood hazard zone
An adult must be present at the inspection

fees.label: Resale inspection, per building (non-multiple use)
fees.quote: Upon the resale of any apartment house, home, dwelling or commercial establishment an inspection shall be conducted of the premises by the Borough Official Inspector for a fee of $75.00 per building for non multiple use.

fees.label: Re-inspection if the home fails, per unit or building
fees.quote: If the premises fails inspection, a re-inspection fee of $25.00 will be charged per unit or building.

fees.label: Flood review (homes in an effective or preliminary flood hazard zone, with Flood Elevation Certificate)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Borough's Application for Resale Existing Structure Certificate of Occupancy and return it to the Construction office at Borough Hall, 801 Ocean Gate Avenue (CN 100), with the $75.00 fee (the form has spaces for check or cash) and the fireplace and furnace certificates. Add a Flood Elevation Certificate and the $110.00 flood review fee if the home is in a flood hazard zone. Office contact on the form: 732-269-3166, Ext 129, ogcode@oceangatenjgov.com. Office hours 9:00 am to 4:00 pm.

resale_co.notes: The Resale Application is a scanned one-page form linked from the Borough's Construction/Code/Zoning page; it is not dated but cites Ordinance #663-22 (flood elevation certificate), so it is from 2022 or later. The form lists the fax as 732-269-6652 while the Clerk page lists (732) 269-6446. Charles White is the Construction Official and Zoning Officer (evenings Monday and Wednesday, 732-269-3166, ext.125, ogconstruction@oceangatenjgov.com); Paul Murphy is the Code Enforcement Official (732-269-3166, ext. 120, ogcodeofficial@oceangatenjgov.com). The Borough also runs a rental license program (Ordinance #698-24: $200.00 initial registration, $125.00 annual renewal, inspection, tenant registration, lead certificate for pre-1978 homes) and short-term rental registration; these are rental-only and not part of a sale. Vacant or foreclosed properties must register on the HERA registry. The Borough code (ecode360 OC1114) could not be opened.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level and outside each separate sleeping area (Borough-posted N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19 sheet)
Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units; AC-powered alarms from the original construction must not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas (not needed if the building has no fuel-burning device and no attached garage)

The Borough-posted sheet (effective January 1, 2019) still lists a portable fire extinguisher (2A-10B:C, no more than 10 pounds, within 10 feet of the kitchen, mounted on its bracket, top no more than 5 feet above the floor, serviced within 12 months or with a recent receipt); state law P.L.2025, c.19 (February 3, 2025) removed the extinguisher from the state requirement

authorities.name: Not confirmed: Ocean Gate Borough Construction / Code office (resale Certificate of Occupancy inspection) or NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety
authorities.how_to_apply: Not confirmed online. The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Ocean Gate, but the DCA's July 2026 list of state-enforced towns does not mark Ocean Gate as a town where the State issues smoke certificates. The Borough's resale Certificate of Occupancy inspection covers fire safety and smoke/CO alarms, and the Borough posts the smoke alarm, CO alarm and extinguisher rules on its Construction page. Call the Construction office (732-269-3166) to confirm whether the resale CO inspection serves as the smoke/CO certificate or whether the seller must apply to the DCA.

fire_cert.notes: Who issues the smoke/CO certificate in Ocean Gate is not settled. The July 2026 LEA registry lists Ocean Gate as State-enforced (S). The DCA fire directory (survey 5/19/2025) names Louis Kilmer (NJ Division of Fire Safety, (609) 633-6132) as fire official and lists NJ Division Fire Safety under smoke detector compliance, but the DCA's newer list of State-enforced towns (revised 7/17/2026) shows Ocean Gate without the 'SC' (Smoke Certs) mark, which in other towns has meant the State does not issue the certificate there. The Borough's own resale Certificate of Occupancy form says the inspection covers fire safety and that smoke/CO detectors are required, and the Construction page posts the smoke/CO/extinguisher rule sheet, so the Borough inspection may serve as the certificate. No fee specific to a smoke certificate was found. If the DCA does handle it, its online portal is https://firesolutions.dca.nj.gov/ultra-fire-home/smoke-application-create/ (fees $45 / $90 / $161 by lead time), but that is not confirmed for Ocean Gate. The Ocean Gate Volunteer Fire Company is the local fire department, not a fire code office.

open_questions: Does the Borough's resale Certificate of Occupancy inspection also serve as the smoke/CO alarm certificate, or must the seller apply to the NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety?
How far ahead of closing to apply for the resale Certificate of Occupancy, and how long it stays valid (not stated on the form).
Whether the $75.00 fee from Ordinance #387-95 is still current (the form is undated).
